description: Source file defining classes and methods related to symbols, variables, functions, and interface blocks in a shader compiler or translator component.

classes.name: TSymbol
classes.description: Base class representing a symbol such as variables, functions, or structures.

classes.name: TVariable
classes.description: Derived class representing a variable symbol with a specific type.

classes.name: TStructure
classes.description: Represents a structure type with fields and related methods.

classes.name: TInterfaceBlock
classes.description: Represents an interface block with layout qualifiers and fields.

classes.name: TFunction
classes.description: Represents a function symbol with parameters, return type, and related properties.

methods.name: addParameter
methods.description: Adds a parameter variable to the function.

methods.name: buildMangledName
methods.description: Constructs a mangled name for the function based on its parameters.

methods.name: isMain
methods.description: Checks if the function is the main entry point.

methods.name: isImageFunction
methods.description: Checks if the function is an image-related built-in function.

methods.name: isAtomicCounterFunction
methods.description: Checks if the function is an atomic counter related built-in.

methods.name: hasSamplerInStructOrArrayParams
methods.description: Checks if any parameters contain samplers in structures or arrays.

methods.name: hasSamplerInStructOrArrayOfArrayParams
methods.description: Checks if any parameters contain samplers in structures or arrays of arrays.
